skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: To Evoke the Anima
skins.content: Achievement Star Collection/To Evoke the Anima. Sesa loves games, especially sandbox survival ones with plenty of computer-wrecking bugs. Still, with the 'Garb of the Soulseer', he can overcome any issue, somehow.
skins.quote:
'You've got skills!'
'All that exists has a soul. To approach true greatness, the first step is to sense the—Hey! Where're you going?'
'Oh, uh, there's a sale going on over there!'
